text:
Maria (Marketing): quick ops / split test q — for next Wed webinar: are we keeping cloud recording + auto-transcript or doing local recording for higher fidelity?
Jon (Events): leaning cloud + auto-transcript so replay posting is faster. local only if speaker needs raw files.
Lee (Demand Gen): cloud is fine, but we need to confirm retention & who gets the link. can we gate replay for registrants only for 7 days? :thinking_face: 
Sam (Ops): Zoom settings I recommend: Cloud Recording ON, Audio transcript ON, Record active speaker + gallery. Retention: export to S3 and then purge from Zoom after 30 days for compliance.
Maria (Marketing): perfect — Sam can you set the S3 bucket prefix to `events/2026-03-xx/` and set lifecycle 90d? also we need captions file (.vtt) added to replay page.
Sam (Ops): will do. I'll add lifecycle rule and a one-off job to copy cloud recordings to s3 right after event. Jon — do you want the raw mp4 + vtt or an edited clip?
Jon (Events): raw + vtt please. We'll take a 2-min highlight separately for socials.
Olivia (Sales): fyi — need attendee vs registrant segmentation in HubSpot. Send attendees who watched > 50% to SDR queue within 1 hour.
Lee (Demand Gen): noted. Proposed post-event routing: immediately email registrants with replay + transcript; 24h send "did you make it?" to non-attendees; 48h nudge to attendees with CTA to book demo. Also tag attendees with `webinar_attended` and `watch_pct` property.
Maria (Marketing): suggested email bodies: 1) Immediate — "Thanks for joining / replay inside" with CTA to short survey. 2) 24h non-attend — "We missed you, here’s the highlights" + CTA to watch. 3) 48h attendees — "Loved the discussion? Book a consult" with calendar link.
Lee (Demand Gen): can we add a hidden query param for UTM and a unique replay token so we can track watch % per recipient?
Sam (Ops): yes. I'll bake a signed token generator into the replay page: `GET /replay?token=<signed>` then write watch events to analytics.
Maria (Marketing): reminder for registration page copy — include note about caption/transcript + expected replay delivery time (within 2 hours after event). Lee, can you update confirmation copy and confirmation email?
Lee (Demand Gen): on it. I'll push new copy to the CMS and patch the confirmation email template.
Jon (Events): Zoom permission check — make sure speakers are set as co-hosts (so recording includes their names and we can clip). Also confirm "Allow cloud recording access to authenticated users only" is OFF (we want public replay link).
Sam (Ops): auth-only is OFF per policy for public webinars. I'll also enable post-processing to generate VTT and include speaker timestamps.
zoom-bot: Recording scheduled for 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC — cloud recording enabled.
Maria (Marketing): final ask — automate lead routing via Zapier -> HubSpot mapping: `if watch_pct >= 50 -> owner = SDR_Queue_A`; `if watch_pct < 50 but opened replay -> nurture_flow`. Lee/Sam can we sync mapping by EOD Friday?
Lee (Demand Gen): yes, I'll draft the Zap filter and share snippet: ```if event.watch_pct >= 50 then add_contact_property('priority','high') -> assign_to('SDR_Queue_A') else add_to_list('webinar_nurture')```
Sam (Ops): I'll validate the webhook delivery and make sure retries are on.
Olivia (Sales): once routing is live, I'll prep a 1-pager for SDRs with recommended intro lines and the top 3 talking points.
Maria (Marketing): amazing — action items: Sam copy to S3 + lifecycle, Lee update copy + HubSpot mapping, Jon confirm co-hosts + highlight clip workflow, Olivia SDR 1-pager. I'll follow up with the replay email templates and schedule a quick run-through 24h before. :thumbsup:
Jon (Events): noted. I'll post final speaker brief with recording expectations tomorrow.
Maria (Marketing): thanks everyone — closing thread until morning.
